correctness.rationale: Literal multiplication in kQ_n/J⁴ gives α_iα_(i+1)=0 and α_iβ_(i+1)+α_(i+2)β_i=0, with the degree-three layer free. Under an independent arrow support, the bipartite coefficient graph has only one-edge and two-edge components because no edge is simultaneously at two degree-two vertices. Its rank is exactly 2|S|−p₂(S)−p₃(S) in every characteristic. Fiber counting proves the point formula; the five-state trace matrix and its characteristic polynomial prove the recurrence. Constant-rank kernel bundles over support tori are geometrically irreducible; the sharp gap-two/gap-three criterion classifies the top-dimensional ones. A standalone finite-field verifier independently checks nine coefficient-enumeration configurations, including GF(4), and literal multiplication.

value.rationale: For a classical family of finite-dimensional cyclic Nakayama algebras, the first truncation where two radical layers interact under square-zero equations is analyzed completely. The coefficient-independent support-rank theorem gives an all-field finite-state recurrence for exact order-two element frequencies in characteristic two and simultaneously determines dimension and every top-dimensional component using a nontrivial gap-two/gap-three composition count. These are natural invariants across an infinite family, not merely an isolated small-field census.
